description: StudioAnchor Reach is contact management and email marketing built for dance studios. Connect your Reach workspace to find contacts, organize them with tags, review campaign results and inbound replies, draft campaign emails, and manage automation sequences. Read actions stay inside the connected workspace. Actions that can change data say so explicitly, and campaign sends use a prepare-then-confirm flow that shows the intended audience and estimated recipient count before real email is queued. Depending on the studio's Reach settings, a committed send may also wait for human approval inside Reach.

defaultPrompt: Show me the active contacts in Reach who have the tag recital-lead.
